If information is requested by a Contracting State in  accordance with this Article, the other Contracting State  shall use its information gathering measures to obtain the  requested information, even though that other State may not  need such information for its own tax purposes. The  obligation contained in the preceding sentence is subject to  the limitations of paragraph 3 but in no case shall such  limitations be construed to permit a Contracting State to  decline to supply information solely because it has no  domestic interest in such information.<br />
   5. In no case shall the provisions of paragraph 3 be  construed to permit a Contracting State to decline to supply  information solely because the information is held by a bank,  other financial institution, nominee or person acting in an  agency or a fiduciary capacity or because it relates to  ownership interests in a person.<p><a name="P2S221"></a></p><h4 name="Article 26"><a name="Article 26">Article 26</a></h4><p><a name="P2S222"></a></p><h4 name="Limitations of benefits"><a name="Limitations of benefits">Limitations of benefits</a></h4><p><a name="P2S223"></a></p>

Notwithstanding any other provisions of this Convention,  where<p><a name="P2S224"></a></p>

(a) a company that is a resident of a Contracting State  derives its income primarily from other States<p><a name="P2S225"></a></p>

(i) from activities such as banking, shipping, financing or  insurance or<p><a name="P2S226"></a></p>

(ii) from being the headquarters, co-ordination centre or  similar entity providing administrative services or other  support to a group of companies which carry on business  primarily in other States; and<p><a name="P2S227"></a></p>

(b) except for the application of the method of elimination  of double taxation normally applied by that State, such  income would bear a significantly lower tax under the laws of  that State than income from similar activities carried out  within that State or from being the headquarters,  co-ordination centre or similar entity providing  administrative services or other support to a group of  companies which carry on business in that State, as the case  may be,<br />
any provisions of this Convention conferring an exemption or  a reduction of tax shall not apply to the income of such  company and to the dividends paid by such company.<p><a name="P2S228"></a></p><h4 name="Article 27"><a name="Article 27">Article 27</a></h4><p><a name="P2S229"></a></p><h4 name="Members of diplomatic missions and consular posts"><a name="Members of diplomatic missions and consular posts">Members of diplomatic missions and consular posts</a></h4><p><a name="P2S230"></a></p>

Nothing in this Convention shall affect the fiscal privileges  of members of diplomatic missions and consular posts under  the general rules of international law or under the  provisions of special agreements.<p><a name="P2S231"></a></p><h4 name="Article 28"><a name="Article 28">Article 28</a></h4><p><a name="P2S232"></a></p>

Entry into force<br />
   1. The Contracting States shall notify each other in writing,  through diplomatic channels, that the procedures required by  their domestic laws for entry into force of this Convention  have been complied with.<br />
   2. The Convention shall enter into force on the thirtieth day  after the receipt of the later of these notifications and  shall thereupon have effect <p><a name="P2S233"></a></p>

(a) in respect of taxes withheld at source, for amounts paid  or credited on or after the first day of January of the year  next following the date on which the Convention enters into  force;<p><a name="P2S234"></a></p>

(b) in respect of other taxes on income, on taxes chargeable  for any tax year beginning on or after the first day of  January of the year next following the date on which the  Convention enters into force.<p><a name="P2S235"></a></p><h4 name="Article 29"><a name="Article 29">Article 29</a></h4><p><a name="P2S236"></a></p><h4 name="Termination"><a name="Termination">Termination</a></h4><p><a name="P2S237"></a></p>

This Convention shall remain in force until terminated by a  Contracting State. Either Contracting State may terminate the  Convention, through diplomatic channels, by giving written  notice of termination at least six months before the end of  any calendar year. In such case, the Convention shall cease  to have effect <p><a name="P2S238"></a></p>

(a) in respect of taxes withheld at source, for amounts paid  or credited on or after the first day of January of the year  next following the end of the six month period;<p><a name="P2S239"></a></p>

(b) in respect of other taxes on income, on taxes chargeable  for any tax year beginning on or after the first day of  January of the year next following the end of the six month  period.<p><a name="P2S240"></a></p>

In witness whereof the undersigned being duly authorized  thereto have signed this Convention.<p><a name="P2S241"></a></p>

Done at Baku, this 10th day of February 2016, in duplicate in  the Swedish, Azerbaijani and English languages, all three  texts being equally authentic. In case of divergence in  interpretation between the texts the English text shall  prevail.<p><a name="P2S242"></a></p><h4 name="For the Government of the Kingdom of Sweden"><a name="For the Government of the Kingdom of Sweden">For the Government of the Kingdom of Sweden</a></h4><p><a name="P2S243"></a></p><h4 name="Margot Wallström"><a name="Margot Wallström">Margot Wallström</a></h4><p><a name="P2S244"></a></p><h4 name="For the Government of the Republic of Azerbaijan"><a name="For the Government of the Republic of Azerbaijan">For the Government of the Republic of Azerbaijan</a></h4><p><a name="P2S245"></a></p><h4 name="Elmar Mammadyarov"><a name="Elmar Mammadyarov">Elmar Mammadyarov</a></h4><p><a name="P2S246"></a></p><h4 name="Protocol"><a name="Protocol">Protocol</a></h4><p><a name="P2S247"></a></p>

At the signing of the Convention between the Government of  the Kingdom of Sweden and the Government of the Republic of  Azerbaijan for the avoidance of double taxation and the  prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income,  the undersigned have agreed that the following shall form an  integral part of the Convention:<p><a name="P2S248"></a></p><h4 name="With reference to Article 1"><a name="With reference to Article 1">With reference to Article 1</a></h4><p><a name="P2S249"></a></p>

For the purposes of Swedish tax, in the case of an item of  income derived by or through a person that is fiscally  transparent under Swedish law, such item shall be considered  to be derived by a resident of a Contracting State to the  extent that the item is treated for the purposes of the  taxation law of such State as the income of a resident.<p><a name="P2S250"></a></p><h4 name="With reference to Article 2"><a name="With reference to Article 2">With reference to Article 2</a></h4><p><a name="P2S251"></a></p>

The fees or taxes paid under the Swedish Social Security  Legislation and according to the provisions of the Act 
(1994:1920) on General salary fees, the Act (1990:659) on  Special salary tax on earned income and the Act (1991:687) on  Special salary tax on pension costs or any similar fee or tax  which is imposed after the date of signature of the  Convention, are not covered by the Convention.<p><a name="P2S252"></a></p><h4 name="With reference to Article 5"><a name="With reference to Article 5">With reference to Article 5</a></h4><p><a name="P2S253"></a></p>

For the application of subparagraph (f) of paragraph 2, it is  understood that the words "installation or structure" mean  any kind of fixed place of business used for the exploration  of natural resources even if such fixed place is a ship or a  boat.<p><a name="P2S254"></a></p><h4 name="With reference to Article 8"><a name="With reference to Article 8">With reference to Article 8</a></h4><p><a name="P2S255"></a></p>

With respect to profits derived by the air transport  consortium Scandinavian Airlines System (SAS) the provisions  of paragraph 1 shall apply only to such part of the profits  as corresponds to the participation held in that consortium  by SAS Sverige AB, the Swedish partner of SAS.<p><a name="P2S256"></a></p><h4 name="With reference to Article 13"><a name="With reference to Article 13">With reference to Article 13</a></h4><p><a name="P2S257"></a></p>

With respect to gains derived by the air transport consortium  Scandinavian Airlines System (SAS), the provisions of  paragraph 3 shall apply only to such part of the gains as  corresponds to the participation held in that consortium by  SAS Sverige AB, the Swedish partner of SAS.<p><a name="P2S258"></a></p><h4 name="With reference to Article 15"><a name="With reference to Article 15">With reference to Article 15</a></h4><p><a name="P2S259"></a></p>

Where a resident of Sweden derives remuneration in respect of  an employment exercised aboard an aircraft operated in  international traffic by the air transport consortium  Scandinavian Airlines System (SAS), such remuneration shall  be taxable only in Sweden.<p><a name="P2S260"></a></p>

In witness whereof the undersigned being duly authorized  thereto have signed this Protocol.<p><a name="P2S261"></a></p>

Done at Baku, this 10th day of February 2016, in duplicate in  the Swedish, Azerbaijani and English languages, all three  texts being equally authentic. In case of divergence in  interpretation between the texts the English text shall  prevail.<p><a name="P2S262"></a></p><h4 name="For the Government of the Kingdom of Sweden"><a name="For the Government of the Kingdom of Sweden">For the Government of the Kingdom of Sweden</a></h4><p><a name="P2S263"></a></p><h4 name="Margot Wallström"><a name="Margot Wallström">Margot Wallström</a></h4><p><a name="P2S264"></a></p><h4 name="For the Government of the Republic of Azerbaijan"><a name="For the Government of the Republic of Azerbaijan">For the Government of the Republic of Azerbaijan</a></h4><p><a name="P2S265"></a></p><h4 name="Elmar Mammadyarov"><a name="Elmar Mammadyarov">Elmar Mammadyarov</a></h4><p><a name="P2S266"></a></p></div></html><dokumentnamn>Svensk författningssamling</dokumentnamn><avdelningar><avdelning>dokument</avdelning></avdelningar></dokument><dokumentuppgift not="Obsolet - använd dokuppgift"><uppgift><kod>artal</kod><namn>artal</namn><text>2016</text></uppgift><uppgift><kod>utfardad</kod><namn>utfardad</namn><text>2016-10-19</text></uppgift><uppgift><kod>andrattillochmed</kod><namn>andrattillochmed</namn><text>t.o.m.
